offering_description.value: Verra Mobility handles tolls, traffic violations and vehicle registration for rental car companies and commercial fleets. It installs and operates automated traffic enforcement systems for public agencies. It also supplies parking management software and equipment to universities, municipalities and parking operators.

primary_products.value: Automated traffic enforcement camera systems; parking management software; parking payment and access equipment

primary_services.value: Fleet toll processing; traffic violation administration; vehicle titling and registration; managed traffic enforcement; parking payment and permit processing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Rental car companies, fleet operators, fleet management companies, private universities and parking operators; B2G: Municipalities, transportation agencies, law enforcement agencies and public universities; B2C: Rental car drivers who pay for electronic toll processing

end_markets.value: Car rental; commercial fleet management; public road safety; parking operations; higher education

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Electronic toll processing for rental and fleet vehicles; project or contract: Installation, operation and maintenance of automated traffic enforcement systems under public agency contracts; service fees: Fleet violation administration, vehicle titling and registration; product sales: Enforcement cameras, parking pay stations and access equipment; subscription: Cloud-based parking management software
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; project or contract; service fees; product sales; subscription

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Processes toll, violation and vehicle records for rental companies, fleets and public agencies; software / platform: Integrates vehicle, camera and payment data for fleets, public agencies and parking operators; OEM / manufacturer: Builds automated enforcement and parking systems from camera, sensor and payment components for agencies and parking operators
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; OEM / manufacturer

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, parts of Europe and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: Fleet toll and vehicle administration, automated traffic enforcement and parking management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Contracts with rental car companies, fleet operators, public agencies, universities and parking operators; partners / resellers: Rental car companies offer electronic toll payment to renters; online: Driver portals for rental toll payments and parking payments

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: State and local automated enforcement laws, toll authority rules, vehicle registration requirements and driver data privacy laws
